name: ComplexIllustration
description: Larger full-scene illustration assets. 2 variants: document-preview (used in document viewer contexts) and privacy-policy (used on privacy/consent pages). Each is a 172×172px layered illustration.

usageMap.document-preview: Document viewer empty state / preview placeholder
usageMap.privacy-policy: Privacy policy / consent agreement page hero

usage.notes: Export as SVG from Figma for best quality at any size. Use as hero illustration in full-page or modal contexts. Composed of multiple Freepik character + object layers.

do: Use with accompanying title and description text.
dont: Don't use without surrounding context text.
